notes: Two sayings: the first is Jabir's figure reached Qatada by «بلغني» (an unnamed gap, rule 8); the second is Sa'id b. al-Musayyab's answer «فقال لي سعيد حدثني جابر» with its own isnad. The second is not read as a route here: needs ruling (rule 11).
«قال أبو داود حدثنا قرة عن قتادة» is a remark naming a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group. Abu Dawud is the speaker of that remark, not a link.
«سعيد» before «قتادة» is written bare; it is kept as written and not merged with Sa'id b. al-Musayyab.
